# R Markdown
## Sub-header
### Another, smaller sub-header  

>This is a block quote

1. Step 1
1. Step 2
1. Step 3
1. Step 5

* First bullet
* Second bullet
  - Sub-bullet

First Header  | Second Header
------------- | -------------
Content Cell  | Content Cell
Content Cell  | Content Cell

![image link](img/rmarkdownflow.png)

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see [mylink](http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com).

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.

```{r demo chunk, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
x <- 1
y <- 13
print(x + y)
```
